scope: Manually registered anterior chin surface; no skeletal inference.

nlm_chin.use: Chin is the anterior mandibular region containing the mental protuberance. No dimensions or illustrations copied.

nih_oral.use: Mentolabial sulcus defines the central lower boundary of the lip region.

relationships.relation: upper protection boundary for this chin edit
relationships.note: Using it as an edit boundary is an authored modeling choice.

coordinate_policy: u and v are authored offsets scaled by registered chin half-width; all control sources are ray-projected to visible skin. Ratios are not population measurements.
limits: Static soft-tissue contour only; no inferred bone, dental occlusion, demographic accuracy or jaw motion.
